description: Show differences between files in a two column view.

option.name: --color-map
tip: Choose which colors are used for which items.
Default: add:green_bold,change:yellow_bold,description:blue,line-numbers:white,meta:magenta,permissions:yellow,separator:blue,subtract:red_bold.

option.name: --cols
tip: Specify the width of the screen.
Autodetection is Unix only.

option.name: --encoding
tip: Specify the file encoding.
Defaults to utf8.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude files that match PAT.

option.name: --exclude-lines
tip: Do not diff lines that match this regex.
Not compatible with the 'line-numbers' option.

option.name: --head
tip: Consider only the first N lines of each file.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help message and exit.

option.name: --highlight
tip: Color by changing the background color instead of the foreground color.
Very fast, ugly, displays all changes.

option.name: --is-git-diff
tip: Show the real file name when displaying git-diff result.

option.name: --label
tip: Override file labels with arbitrary tags.
Use twice, one for each file.
You may include the formatting strings '{path}' and '{basename}'.

option.name: --line-numbers
tip: Generate output with line numbers.
Not compatible with the 'exclude-lines' option.

option.name: --no-bold
tip: Use non-bold colors.
Recommended for solarized.

option.name: --no-headers
tip: Don't label the left and right sides with their file names.

option.name: --numlines
tip: How many lines of context to print.
Can't be combined with --whole-file.
Defaults to 5.

option.name: --output-encoding
tip: Specify the output encoding.
Defaults to utf8.

option.name: --patch
tip: Generate patch.
This is always true, and only exists for compatibility.

option.name: --permissions
tip: Compare the file permissions as well as the content of the file.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Recursively compare subdirectories.

option.name: --report-identical-files
tip: Report when two files are the same.

option.name: --show-all-spaces
tip: Color all non-matching whitespace, including that which is not needed for drawing the eye to changes.
Slow, ugly, displays all changes.

option.name: --show-no-spaces
tip: Don't color whitespace-only changes.

option.name: --strip-trailing-cr
tip: Strip any trailing carriage return at the end of an input line.

option.name: --tabsize
tip: Tab stop spacing.
Defaults to 8.

option.name: --truncate
tip: Truncate long lines instead of wrapping them.

option.name: --version
tip: Show program's version number and exit.

option.name: --whole-file
tip: Show the whole file instead of just changed lines and context.
